subject: Civic Education
competence: Faces different problems and challenges in life successfully.
unique_learning_outcome: Explains that facing problems is common in life.
Explains that any challenge or any problem has a solution.
Explains the need of searching for creative solutions for any challenge or problem for success in life.
the_entrance: Following innovative ways to solve different problems and challenges

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of facing problems and challenges in life successfully.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Listen to the teacher's explanation and take notes.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Formative assessment check on student understanding

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on the importance of facing problems and challenges.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Participate in group discussions and share thoughts on the topic.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and correct misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations on the solutions to different problems and challenges.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Present group findings and compare notes with peers.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Consolidate learning and conduct formative evaluation.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Summative check for all learning outcomes

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles: facing problems and challenges in life successfully.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
attachments: Worksheet: 'Facing Problems and Challenges in Life Successfully'
